requirements.title: Customer product interfaces and internal acceptance separation
acceptance: Staff and patient entry and everyday workspaces use reviewed product/clinic information, with no academic or developer acceptance framing.
Internal acceptance routes have their own authorization; ordinary users are not directed to them.
Unavailable clinical capabilities are not rendered as working or certified.
required_evidence: actual browser ordinary and exception journeys
requirements.implementation_notes: C0.3 local service-channel/browser acceptance recorded. Full commercial role/task inventory and clinical-workspace usability remain planned; not completed by service-page delivery.

requirements.title: Patient service discovery, content publication and booking continuation
acceptance: Public service descriptions explain purpose, appointment contents, exclusions, preparation and explicit fee terms; general guides do not imply clinic availability.
Only complete, explicitly published, operationally enabled clinic offerings are projected; missing fees are never zero and private clinician/patient fields stay private.
Current-clinic managers can create, preview, publish or withdraw with scoped confirmation, audit, stale revision and replay guards; draft previews cannot book.
Typed service selection survives normal patient activation and multi-role selection without selecting authority or arbitrary URLs; expiry, revocation and new-login behavior are explicit.
Availability searches the bounded existing horizon, enforces compatible clinicians, and confirmation records an optional own-patient visit reason without changing clinical or billing authority.
Children requiring guardian/delegate verification use a front-desk path until the separate authorization requirement is implemented.
required_evidence: ordinary and negative customer/manager browser journeys at 390px and with keyboard/non-JS
requirements.release_scope: 2026-10-23 local synthetic installation only; C0.3 execution record; not cloud/WeChat runtime/commercial clinical qualification

requirements.title: Native service discovery and publication-consistent patient booking
acceptance: Native discovery/detail reuse complete published operational profiles; draft/private fields are absent and fee NULL, zero and starting terms remain distinct.
Typed selected service survives discovery/detail/booking; child, stale and missing service inputs cannot create new self-bookings or waitlist requests.
Signed preview binds optional visit request; raw confirmation edits cannot replace it or financial/service inputs.
New booking/waitlist confirmation rechecks publication under shared locks/revisions; successful receipt replay preserves the current saved result.
Own historical service rescheduling and retained offers do not depend on public marketing visibility.
Customer copy is professional with server-owned accurate environment presentation; actual native/runtime qualification is recorded separately.
required_evidence: official compiler and native runtime journeys

requirements.title: Separate presentation data provenance and production qualification
acceptance: Brand presentation cannot grant authority or mark a release accepted.
Isolated test environments retain an accurate environment indicator and synthetic-document provenance.
Clean production initialization refuses demo bootstrap/accounts/configuration and does not overwrite existing installations.
requirements.implementation_notes: Compact environment presentation implemented; clean production initialization and environment acceptance remain planned.

requirements.title: First clinic complete service and integration contract
acceptance: Each contracted dental service maps to required record, consent, order, execution, material, imaging, follow-up and financial behavior.
Every required first-customer interface and legal jurisdiction has an accountable reviewer.
No clinical replacement claim is made while a required service or interface is incomplete.

requirements.title: Verified patients guardians and source-aware import
acceptance: Patient binding and recovery do not authenticate through phone number or business ID alone.
Guardian/delegate access is separately verified, bounded and revocable.
Duplicate and ambiguous imports are reviewed rather than silently merged.

requirements.title: Clinical professional scope and attributable permissions
acceptance: Nursing, pharmacy, records and inventory responsibilities have explicit patient/object/action scope.
Qualification validity, evidence source and verifier are recorded; directory associations do not auto-qualify staff.
Changing clinic or role cannot self-approve, expand access or revive stale forms.

requirements.title: Customer account activation recovery and session governance
acceptance: Production accounts are attributable and use reviewed activation/reset procedures with no reused public demo credentials.
Privileged MFA, inactivity/absolute lifetime and session inspection/revocation have a documented threat model.
Account departure and credential changes invalidate applicable sessions and capabilities.

requirements.title: Structured dental encounters and quality worklists
acceptance: Contracted first/follow-up record templates support complaint/history, examination, diagnosis, plan, performed facts and follow-up.
Patient-reported and professionally confirmed facts, unknown and reviewed-negative histories remain distinct.
Missing required content, wrong encounter and conflicting revisions have understandable safe outcomes.
required_evidence: HTTP concurrency and browser record tests

requirements.title: Odontogram periodontal data and service-specific dental findings
acceptance: The approved tooth/surface and dentition conventions are stored explicitly and have an accessible structured input path.
Contracted periodontal, restorative, endodontic, orthodontic or implant fields are captured where applicable.
Graphical changes preserve actor/time/version and cannot invent completed treatment or charges.

requirements.title: Longitudinal treatment plans and safe draft saving
acceptance: Multi-encounter plans preserve proposed/completed/cancelled steps and revision history.
Draft saves bind author, patient, encounter and revision; switching patients cannot transfer note content.
Acknowledge a save only after durable commit; handle response loss and conflicts without duplicate or lost accepted changes in the tested model.

requirements.title: Clinical signatures and immutable amendment lifecycle
acceptance: Writing, review, signing and archive permissions/deadlines are explicit.
Original signed content, signer evidence, authoritative time and verification remain recoverable after amendment.
A typed name or signature picture is not represented as a verified reliable-signature integration.

requirements.title: Consent archive controlled copies and retention
acceptance: Consent binds the correct person/procedure/version and supports applicable guardian authority.
Archive, independently readable copies, permitted amendment, legal holds and required retention are enforced.
Optional-consent withdrawal and customer exit cannot erase records with a remaining lawful retention obligation.

requirements.title: Protected clinical attachments and imaging identity
acceptance: Files and imaging references bind the authorized patient/encounter and source identity, with controlled retrieval and no public objects.
Upload bounds/content checks and malware-handling behavior are defined and tested.
Diagnostic viewing and PACS requirements are reviewed independently of a generic image upload.

requirements.title: Reviewed medication dictionaries and prescriber authority
acceptance: Drug identity/strength/units/routes and all required prescription fields use reviewed controlled dictionaries.
Prescriber scopes and validity are checked again when a prescription is signed.
Safety rules use a licensed maintained reviewed knowledge source, retain its version and show unknown coverage.

requirements.title: Prescription review corrections and charge prerequisites
acceptance: Approved review precedes corresponding medication pricing/charging and dispensing in the adopted workflow.
Rejection, corrected revision, cancellation and stale/revoked professional context retain prior history and cannot bypass review.
Any applicable lawful exception has its own reviewed attributable workflow rather than a generic bypass.

requirements.title: Dispensing administration and partial fulfilment
acceptance: Dispensing and administration have distinct accountable professional events.
Partial fulfilment, returns, cancellations and replay cannot double-dispense or erase completed use.
External prescription delivery and required paper/electronic documents are tested for the actual clinic.

requirements.title: Drug material implant lots and stock movements
acceptance: Receipt, expiry, issue/use, return and recall preserve source and patient/order linkage for applicable items.
Concurrent use cannot over-issue or produce negative stock under the defined command protocol.
Corrections append attributable reversing/new movements and do not delete earlier events.

requirements.title: Nursing execution sterilization and specialty traceability
acceptance: Applicable instrument/package/sterilization evidence links to actual use and patient care.
Nursing records actual execution and escalation instead of merely copying planned orders.
Specialty execution and infection-control exceptions have accountable owners; general clinical recall moves to CLIN-04/C2 and internal laboratory readiness to LAB-01/C2.
requirements.scope_refinement: 2026-10-23: split early non-drug recall/lab coordination from the later stock/sterilization workflow; preserve full professional execution gate.

requirements.title: Lab prosthetic and imaging integration lifecycle
acceptance: Patient/study/order identity, source result/version and authorizations are preserved end-to-end.
Send/acknowledge/result/correction and provider outage/replay outcomes are visible and reconciled.
A required first-customer interface is not marked available based on a local mock or screenshot.
required_evidence: real authorized sandbox or target integration evidence
outage replay and wrong-patient negative cases
requirements.scope_refinement: LAB-01/C2 provides internal/manual case tracking. INT-01 still requires actual authorized supplier/imaging interface evidence.

requirements.title: Clinical source charges and treatment-course allocations
acceptance: Performed events, estimates, prescription approvals, bills and deposits are different attributed facts.
Existing invoice/version amounts are preserved; plan revisions cannot silently charge/refund or create an independent duplicate line source.
Required deposits, split settlements and refunds have reviewed allocation and reversal rules.
required_evidence: clinical correction and historical version regression
requirements.scope_refinement: Define and verify the unique non-drug performed-event charging bridge in C2.2. Full FIN-01 release continues to require RX-02 and required deposit/allocation/provider work; no duplicate billing source.

requirements.title: Real payment refunds reconciliation and required fiscal interfaces
acceptance: Server-verified provider events bind correct merchant/order/amount; duplicate callbacks do not duplicate posting.
Timeout, unknown result, refund and later reconciliation stay attributable; client success never counts as receipt evidence.
Required insurance/tax interfaces are accepted with actual access; documents describe their legal status accurately.

requirements.title: Patient communication delivery support and permissions
acceptance: Care communication and optional marketing use reviewed permission handling and message content.
Queued/sent/provider-delivered/failed states reflect actual provider evidence and never promise human receipt without it.
Support and complaint handling have explicit ownership and minimum necessary record access.
required_evidence: support access and incident workflow review

requirements.title: Sensitive read export retention and processor governance
acceptance: Lawful bases/notices/consent where applicable, data categories/purposes/retention and processor/subprocessor responsibilities are mapped.
Reads, copies, bulk export and emergency-access proposals have enforceable purpose/object/role controls and bounded safe audit.
Routine logs/telemetry and external AI do not receive raw medical records, credentials or tokens.
requirements.scope_refinement: Begin object/purpose-scoped reads and safe audit with C1.2. C7 remains the full retention/processor/target-environment acceptance gate.

requirements.title: Independent deployment customer isolation and monitored recovery
acceptance: Customer deployments isolate database/objects/secrets/keys/sessions/backups and operate independently of the Mac.
HTTPS/private DB/least privilege/workers/monitoring/off-host encrypted recovery have responsible operators.
Restore covers SQL, objects, signature/key dependencies and measured full-service recovery with business-approved RPO/RTO.
required_evidence: real target deployment and fault evidence

requirements.title: Additive clinical migration and rehearsed replacement cutover
acceptance: Preserve all 40 current migrations and historical facts; old free-text/billing data is not fabricated into missing clinical events or diagnoses.
Real source records are mapped with provenance and reviewed ambiguities; row/version/signature/attachment/amount comparisons are independent.
Write freeze, final delta, downtime procedure, named acceptance and data-preserving rollback/forward recovery are rehearsed.

requirements.title: Clinical safety security usability and commercial capacity qualification
acceptance: Every contracted clinical service passes ordinary and failure workflows with the relevant professionals.
Exact release passes current PG/HTTP/concurrency, browser, sensitive-access, load and recovery gates; no unresolved critical defects.
Capacity/SLO/usability measurements use the stated workload/sample and are not represented as market-wide or compliance certification.
required_evidence: real workload 24 h soak and observed user tasks

requirements.title: Repeatable licence support exit and customer handover
acceptance: Licence/service/support scope, external supplier costs and responsibilities are explicit and funded.
Installation, onboarding, training, updates, incidents, key custody and customer-readable export/exit are rehearsed.
No unsupported price, support-hours, uptime or certification promise is used in product/sales material.
required_evidence: fresh independent installation and export rehearsal

requirements.title: Supervised full-workflow first-customer commercial pilot
acceptance: All critical clinical/privacy/prescription/recovery controls work before any real patient pilot.
Agreed service scope and observation period run with support, defect handling and retained business evidence.
Wider branch rollout follows named clinical/operational/customer acceptance rather than a version label.

requirements.title: Restricted cross-clinic identity resolution and shared-care authority
acceptance: Resolve identity ambiguity through a limited authorized projection; shared names or contact details never auto-merge patients.
Cross-clinic chart access requires explicit current care authority, not merely chain membership or a successful search.
Retain requested/approved/refused/revoked transfer evidence and preserve original clinic records.

requirements.title: Clinical recall and unfinished-care responsibility
acceptance: Clinical staff define due windows; front desk owns contact and booking, with named responsibility and overdue work.
Contacted, booked, attended and clinically completed are distinct; cancellation restores appropriate unfinished work.
Declined, deferred and unreachable outcomes retain attributable decisions and do not fabricate clinical completion.

requirements.title: Internal laboratory cases and appointment readiness
acceptance: Record supplier/case identity, due time and dispatch/return; patient and clinical source are consistent.
Receipt, quality acceptance and rework are distinct; missing readiness creates an owned coordination item.
Preserve the original appointment until explicit authorized coordination; synthetic/manual acknowledgements never imply actual integration.

requirements.title: Supporting-team capacity and staged resource occupancy
acceptance: Front desk retains daily schedule ownership; clinical staff define required team and readiness constraints.
Any phased occupancy model preserves old full-slot plans and prevents conflicting actual use.
Changes protect existing promises and require explicit coordination, with no autonomous overbooking.

requirements.title: Consistent clinical and operational outcome measures
acceptance: Version appointment, care-plan, recall and lab denominators; distinguish mature cohorts, reschedules and actual completion.
Report quality/rework/overdue work alongside recorded financial facts; absent costs do not support profit claims.
HQ receives authorized aggregates and no contact or clinical text; changes remain reconcilable to source events.

requirements.title: Host collector diagnosis and sustained service evidence
acceptance: Expose bounded collection-stage and error-category evidence without raw sensitive payloads.
Retain historical UNKNOWN and unreproduced failure; distinguish collection failure from healthy-host evidence.
Close incidents only with attributable handling and appropriate fresh/sustained observations; target recovery includes required objects and dependencies.
required_evidence: collector failure reproduction or explicitly retained uncertainty

requirements.title: Local regulatory reporting and institution interface applicability
acceptance: Determine the actual jurisdiction and required clinic reporting/interface contract.
Map minimum necessary fields, institution identifiers, purpose and accountable review before exchange.
Required interfaces pass actual authorized target tests; mocks or a generic standards link cannot mark them available.
